name: huddol
description: Run your own organization of agents.

scripts.format: pnpm exec biome format --write . && pnpm format:toml && pnpm format:yaml && uv run --directory core ruff format . && cargo fmt
scripts.check: pnpm check:config && pnpm check:web && pnpm check:core && pnpm check:rust
scripts.check:config: pnpm format:toml:check && pnpm format:yaml:check && actionlint && pnpm exec lefthook validate
scripts.check:web: pnpm exec biome check . && pnpm --dir web typecheck
scripts.check:core: uv run --directory core ruff check . && uv run --directory core ruff format --check . && uv run --directory core mypy src/huddol && uv run --directory core lint-imports
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && node scripts/cargo.mjs check && node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm test:web && pnpm test:core && pnpm test:rust
